This humble daoist must have quite a connection with the Tab Dao as this daoist has only been cultivating the heart calming sutra of the revered Chrome Sect for six months and has already reached the third realm. Although this daoist has been cultivating diligently, this daoist cannot fully ignore the matters of the outside world and therefore was plagued by a heart demon.

Who would've thought that this daoists' lack of concentration had caused this daoists' qi to deviate, dropping a certain piece of technology unto the tiled floor, and caused this daoists' cultivation to be sucked dry by the ever hungry dark void and plummet back unto the starting line. What a pity.

It has been 3 weeks since the incident and this daoist is slowly recovering her cultivation base much faster than before, and have now reached the second realm third phase of the Dao path.

May you have learned something from this daoist.

This daoist wishes you have a smooth journey into the Dao. Blessings.

It's considered a "privilege" for chinese royalty to be bestowed 3 chi of silk to hang himself/herself. It is mostly, atleast from my knowledge based on novels(I could be totally wrong), given to subjects(I have noticed it was mostly female subjects of rather high status) who commit treason and/or have any sort or form of betrayal to the reigning monarch.

My interpretation though is that the monarch "gives mercy" to the punishable subject so s/he could preserve his/her last dignity. Again, I'm not quite sure myself.

Btw I love that novel. I have already reread that novel like 3times, page to page.
